senses.gloss: [? sauparama, adj., acc. to ed. (presumably from *suparama plus -a), supreme: sā sauparamā tathatā niruttarā … Bbh 〔38.26〕 (prose). But prob. read sāsau (sā asau) paramā etc.]
Saupāraka (also spelled in mss. Saurp˚, Śaurp˚, Śaupārika; = Supāraga, Sopāraka, qq.v.), n. of a city: Av 〔ii.166.6 ff.〕
